description_excerpt: Job Purpose: - The Country's Head of Growth - Air Freight is responsible for the overall Air growth initiatives in their country/cluster. The individual guides the country pricing strategy required to achieve the growth ambition and drives execution of this into the stations, including the implementation of relevant value propositions and solution design to support the growth. - Furthermore, the role is responsible for aligning and setting a clear direction for growth in collaboration with the Marketing & Sales organization, including all sales channels.
